pr_title: Use integer lever indices to eliminate UUID contamination in enrich step
pr_description: Integer indices**: Replace `Lever ID: {uuid}` with `Lever 1`, `Lever 2`, etc. in per-batch prompt. Map indices back to full UUIDs when processing the response. Works universally for both text-completion and function-calling models. Positive framing**: "refer to levers by their name" in system prompt Exact-count instruction**: "Return exactly N characterizations — one per lever, no more, no fewer" OPTIMIZE_INSTRUCTIONS**: Document lessons from PRs #457-460 (negative prohibitions backfire, hex prefixes degrade function-calling models, integer indices work universally) Supersedes #458 (negative prohibition backfired on llama3.1) and #460 (6-char prefix degraded haiku).
